messages:
maya: customer reported rerank endpoint returning weird scores after switching embedding provider. says top doc scores are negative and inconsistent.
eli: can you paste the call flow? are they calling /embeddings then /rerank with those vectors?
maya: yes. flow: embed = POST /v1/embeddings model=open-embedding-384, then rerank = POST /v1/rerank model=rnk-large-v2 with the vectors in `query_embedding` field. no errors on API, just odd scores.
jon: if emb dim != rerank expected dim we usually return 400. did they get 200?
maya: 200. body looks like: "{ \"query_embedding\": [[...384 floats...]], \"candidates\": [...] }"
ingrid: so runtime accepted and computed dot products? that sounds like we implicitly padded/truncated or did dot with mismatched lengths causing memory read.
eng-ml-oncall: our reranker kernel assumes shape [n,512] for this model. if given 384 we should have validated and rejected. need logs.
maya: attached server log excerpt: `WARN rerank: embedding length mismatch: expected=512 got=384, proceeding with fallback` then later `score=0.0001` for everything.
eli: fallback path noted — it pads with zeros to 512 for performance reasons historically, but that produces low magnitude vectors -> tiny scores. this explains negative/near-zero.
jon: ah ok. customer complaining because other combos (512->512) worked.
maya: customer wants to know either (A) how to fix now, (B) if we will change behavior.
ingrid: advise: immediate workaround = use the rerank model's recommended embed model (rwd-embed-512) or call the rerank model's internal embed endpoint (POST /v1/models/rnk-large-v2/embeddings) to generate compatible vectors.
eli: longer term: we should NOT silently pad. we need explicit validation and a clear 400 with message: "embedding dimension mismatch: expected 512, got 384. generate embeddings with model=rwd-embed-512 or use rerank model's embeddings endpoint."
eng-ml-oncall: I can put a hotfix: change fallback behavior to return 400 + telemetry. will add a one-line check in the rerank entrypoint.
jon: also add SDK-level validation: if using embeddings.then.rerank helpers, validate dims client-side to reduce round trips.
maya: repro snippet for support to send to customer (curl):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
 -d '{\n  "model": "rnk-large-v2",\n  "query_embedding": [[0.1, 0.2, /* truncated to 384 values */ ]],\n  "candidates": [{"id":"a","text":"doc a"}]\n}'
```
maya: attach our internal repro script that generates 384-d random vectors and shows scores collapse.
eli: filing ticket RNW-9342: "rerank: reject mismatched embedding dims; no silent padding". assigning to eng-ml.
eng-ml-oncall: will push hotfix branch tonight (PR -> staging). testcases: 384->reject, 512->pass, 384->recreate via rnk model's embed endpoint -> pass.
jon: customer communication: please tell them the cause and recommend using the compatible embed model or the model-specific embeddings endpoint. offer to help convert vectors if they need (one-off).
maya: I'll respond with that and link RNW-9342. asking ETA for hotfix?
eng-ml-oncall: aiming for staging by EOD, prod rollback control tomorrow morning, will post deploy notification.
eli: also add a nice error doc snippet in support KB so this doesn't keep recurring: sample error + fix + repro.
maya: thanks — I'll send workaround and offer map script to convert 384->512 by re-embedding (not padding).
support-bot: Incident RNW-9342 created and linked to channel. :white_check_mark:
maya: closing loop: customer replied they can switch to rwd-embed-512 for now, will wait for official fix. updating ticket.
